bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — permit holders or paid parking in marked bays
bays.times: Monday - Friday 10.00am - 4.00pm (core hours from the council CPZ overview map, December 2025; some streets operate different hours — permit-bay enforcement is suspended on bank holidays)
bays.tariff: Pay-by-phone in Waltham Forest CPZs (charges from 1 February 2025, council variation notice T5(25)): up to 30 minutes £1.70; up to 1 hour £2.70; up to 3 hours £4.40. Pay-and-display bays: 30 minutes £1.90; 1 hour £2.90
bays.pay: PayByPhone (app or website); permits via MiPermit

bays.times: Charging hours as signed at the car park
